source: Counted 2026-11-01 (lane #172) from the landmark-brief.ts crops of the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the Commons photograph 'Amsterdam - Het Marnix II' (Picasdre, CC BY 3.0).

facades.name: Marnixstraat: brick sports-hall box
facades.note: Ground storey: one run of frosted glass under the cantilever (mullions only). Above: one ribbon window across nearly the whole front. Brick above with the logo; level top.

facades.name: Singelgracht: aluminium box over the pool glazing
facades.note: One continuous run of pool glazing under the oversailing ribbed box; the box itself is blind.

facades.name: Singelgracht: glass link
facades.note: Curtain wall on a 2.5 m x 1.35 m grid: thin mullions and transoms only, so one opening. Terrace wall in front below 1 m.

facades.name: Marnixplein: north block
facades.note: Two-storey curtain wall (mullions and two transoms) across the front, recessed entrance at the east end inside the same glazed field; blind brick above.

facades.name: Marnixplein block, Marnixstraat end
facades.note: Blind brick with one large stair window low down at the north end; the poster is temporary.

facades.name: South front
facades.note: Ground row: the glazed west end (w07 2022 view) and the dark service doors; first row: the dark louvred band. Brick otherwise.
